title: Now I Know You Fear God

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Do not lay a hand on the boy," he said. "Do not do anything to him. Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son." - Gen 22:12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God speaks the verdict of the test: "Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son." The test had revealed what was truly in Abraham's heart - a reverence for God that held nothing back, not even his most precious treasure. Abraham feared God more than he loved even Isaac.

We should understand what "the fear of God" means here. It is not cringing terror, but reverent awe - a heart that honours God above all else, that trusts and treasures Him supremely. Abraham's willingness to surrender Isaac proved that God held first place in his heart. Nothing, not even his beloved son, was allowed to rival God.

This is the searching heart of the whole chapter. God will sometimes touch the thing we love most, not because He wants to take it, but to reveal whether it has taken His place. Our treasures can quietly become our idols. The test shows us - and gives us the chance to prove - that God is truly first.

Notice the phrase "you have not withheld... your son, your only son." Hold onto those words, because they will echo again in this very chapter, in a way that transforms everything. For now, hear the encouragement: God honours a heart that puts Him first. He does not always require the sacrifice, but He does look for the surrender. Is there anything competing with God for first place in your heart?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Is there anything competing with God for first place in your heart?
- Would a test reveal that God is truly first for you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, search my heart and show me anything that competes with You for first place. Give me a reverent fear that treasures You above all, holding even my dearest gifts with open hands before You.
Amen.
